preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Chevrolet's battery-preconditioning quick-start guide and Charging App help text (chevrolet.com returns 403, so read only as a search excerpt) describe the car automatically preconditioning the battery when you route to a DC fast charger in Google Maps, and a manual Start under Next charge. Not read on a page for this exact model year; applied to this model line on the same Ultium software. UNVERIFIED, weakest for 2023-2024 cars.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Usable 85 kWh / gross 89 kWh. Auto-data (Equinox EV 2024): "89 kWh gross, 85 kWh net"; InsideEVs: calculated pack 89.0 kWh vs reported usable 85 kWh; so the bare "85 kWh" in listings (KBB, existing Chevrolet record) is read as usable. Conflicts with existing records that hold 85 as GROSS (OWNER FLAG).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: The Weekly Driver lists NCMA (NMC family with aluminium) for the 85 kWh 10-module Ultium pack; closest enum nmc.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: InsideEVs gives a calculated nominal pack voltage of 288 V (author-derived, not attributed to GM), a 400 V-class pack. InsideEVs: about 288 V nominal (80S 3P), more like a 300 V system, so 400 V class (not 800 V).

capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Auto-data: 89 kWh gross (InsideEVs calculated 89.0 kWh). Existing records hold 85 kWh as gross (bare listing figure); see the usable note.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: InsideEVs says the Equinox EV "maxes out at 150kW" (not attributed to GM); The Charge Port also records a 150 kW peak in the 2026 specifications (src-thechargeport-equinox-ev). InsideEVs and The Charge Port (2026 specs): 150 kW peak; same pack and hardware 2024-2027 (Wikipedia, KBB). Years on this powertrain: 2024.

ac_max_kw.notes: Wikipedia: 11.5 kW AC, 19.2 kW on the 3RS; The Charge Port 2027: 11.5 kW; NRCan lists Equinox EV AWD (19.2 kW Charger) variants, captured per trim. Powertrain value is the standard 11.5 kW.

published_10_80_min.notes: Estimated: The Charge Port gives about 42 minutes for the 2026 specs; carried to this year because the pack and charger are unchanged. The Charge Port (2027 page) says the 2026 specs listed about 42 min for 10-80 % (Recharged also reports Chevy's site saying 42 min); InsideEVs said GM had not published a 10-80 % time at launch. Model-level claim.
